news.text: #JUVE, NO STOPPING ALLOWEDAway at #Genoa (8:45 PM), #Spalletti is obligated to win againConfirmations are needed after the success in #Lecce. Moving forward with the 3-5-2: alongside #Muani, #Alajbegović will play. Lucio: "The players didn't suggest the formation to me, they would never disrespect me like that. #Kolo? It's not just goals that matter: look at what he does". [Front Page TuttoSport]

📊 #Genoa holds a special place in the Italian career of Gleison #Bremer, the #Juventus defender.Against #Genoa, he scored his first goal in Serie A, on November 30, 2019, back when he was still playing for #Torino, at the Luigi Ferraris stadium.According to Opta, he has scored 3 goals against #Genoa in Serie A, matching his tally against #Cagliari: these are the two opponents he has scored against the most.Additionally, he has secured 7 victories against #Genoa in Serie A, his highest number against a single opponent, equaled only by his record against #Sassuolo.Tomorrow, #Juve visits #Genoa at the Marassi.[@TUTTOJUVE_COM via @PuebloJ]

🧐🆙 January will be important for reshaping the squad based on #Spalletti's tactical needs. The coach considers Nico #González fundamental, so much so that he already reassured him in the summer regarding his central role, but there is still a need to expand the alternatives: with #KoloMuani and #Woltemade being the only pure forwards, it will be necessary to sign a third striker.[Di Marzio via @juventusinsidernews]

👋⁉️ #Juventus could evaluate the departures of #Koopmeiners and #DouglasLuiz in the summer: with a residual value on the balance sheet of around €25M, the club could sell them without registering a capital loss, while also freeing themselves from very heavy salaries. The potential departures would represent an opportunity to generate cash and lighten squad costs, but it remains to be seen whether the club will instead prefer to focus on their revitalization.[Andrea Losapio - TuttoJuve via @juventusinsidernews]
✅‼️Moreover, #Bologna also continues to observe the situation related to Michele #DiGregorio (again regarding the issue of limited playing time).[Mirko Di Natale]

‼️EXCL.#Bologna, #JoaoMario idea. The Portuguese full-back could return to the felsineo club's radar just like last summer given that he is finding little playing time at #Fiorentina. In January, if the situation remains like this, developments are to be monitored.🤝 @manuel_minguzzi[Mirko Di Natale]
